tools.name: move_appointment_to_archive
tools.description: Moves a completed appointment record from the active appointments table into the archive table.

params.name: appointment_id
params.description: ID of the completed appointment to archive

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing

from agents import function_tool


@function_tool
def move_appointment_to_archive(appointment_id: int) -> str:
    with closing(sqlite3.connect("clinic.db")) as conn, conn:
        cur = conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO appointments_archive SELECT * FROM appointments WHERE id = ? AND status = 'completed'",
            (appointment_id,),
        )
        if cur.rowcount == 0:
            return "No completed appointment found with that ID"
        conn.execute("DELETE FROM appointments WHERE id = ?", (appointment_id,))
    return f"Appointment {appointment_id} archived"
